title: OpenAleph isolated development deployment
scope: Start pinned OpenAleph with its required search/database/worker services and restricted synthetic collection

acceptance.text: Start pinned OpenAleph with its required search/database/worker services and restricted synthetic collection
Ingest and retrieve one synthetic document; prove unrelated collection access is denied
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Ingest and retrieve one synthetic document; prove unrelated collection access is denied

evidence.text: Started pinned OpenAleph 5.4.0-rc1 (image revision label = locked commit f89ff18) with required postgres, elasticsearch, redis, ingest, analyze, worker, api and ui services via python3 scripts/openaleph_dev.py up; isolated project rsl-taxathon-openaleph, multi-user password login (ALEPH_SINGLE_USER=false), generated DB password, loopback-only UI 127.0.0.1:55580. Synthetic user A created restricted collection 1 (tax026_synthetic_restricted_a). Fixes recorded in integration/openaleph/README.md: explicit OPENALEPH_DB_URI/PROCRASTINATE_DB_URI, ingest-file 5.4.0-rc4 (same openaleph-procrastinate commit a9c0ef12 as the API; rc1 crashed on every job), 2 gunicorn workers (6 were OOM-killed).

Observed via python3 scripts/openaleph_dev.py smoke (run twice, same result): synthetic text invoice ingested (201), searchable after ~21 s, user A retrieved PlainText entity 200 with contentHash and marker text. Denied: user B collection 403, entity 403, search 0 hits; anonymous collection 403, search 0 hits, create collection 403; invalid API key 403. Idle memory ~3.9 GiB total. tests/tooling/test_openaleph_dev.py 5 tests OK; dev.py check and quality.py passed; staged diff scanned for generated secrets: none.

Tests and evidence recorded for criteria 1-2; task.py finish merged current main (resolved tasks/TAX-026.json conflict from early-merged claim PR #94 by keeping the evidence; files otherwise identical), reran dev.py check and quality.py under Node 24.20.0 (Node 23.5 cannot run the new Vitest suite), pushed task/TAX-026, opened human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/97 and synced issue #27 to IN_REVIEW. Not merged by the agent.

notes.text: Agent finished implementation and opened human review
